_comment: Run template for synthetic-ahu-excess-oa (generated by CAMBER, no real building): outdoor_air_fraction and economizer_high_limit on two air handlers with their declared 20 % design minimum (min_oa_pct) and the economizer's 65 F dry-bulb high limit, so the excess outside air is priced (0.107, #195). Measured: AHU__excess_oa faults on both rules (OA fraction median 44.9 %, every cooling-weather sample above the minimum) and its one issue costs $731/yr, the larger of the two overlapping member estimates, from the trended supply airflow; AHU__excess_oa_no_flow (the same unit without its airflow point) faults the same way but stays uncosted (needs supply_airflow_cfm or design_oa_cfm); AHU__economizer passes both. The cost is in the RCx layout (camber report --layout rcx): Appendix B lists each estimate's minimum, airflow, cooling and heating basis.
